title: manul.config.json
description: Configuration for the manul-browser engine. Command-line flags override these values; environment variables override the file.

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (no visible window). Environment variable: MANUL_HEADLESS.

browser.description: Which browser engine to launch. `chromium` (the default) is driven over CDP; `firefox` is driven over WebDriver BiDi, because Firefox deprecated CDP in 129 and removed it in 141. WebKit/Safari are not supported. Use `channel`/`executable_path` to pick a specific binary. An unrecognised value is an error, not a silent fall back to Chromium. Environment variable: MANUL_BROWSER.

browser_args.description: Extra launch flags passed to the browser. JSON: native array. Env: comma-or-space-separated string. Environment variable: MANUL_BROWSER_ARGS.

timeout.description: Default action timeout for click, fill, select, hover operations. Environment variable: MANUL_TIMEOUT.

nav_timeout.description: Navigation timeout for NAVIGATE, page loads, and WAIT FOR RESPONSE. Environment variable: MANUL_NAV_TIMEOUT.

semantic_cache_enabled.description: Enable in-session semantic cache (learned_elements). Feeds the scorer as one channel (never bypasses scoring); provides a +200,000 scaled score boost within a single run. Resets when the engine instance is destroyed. Environment variable: MANUL_SEMANTIC_CACHE_ENABLED.

custom_controls_dirs.description: Directories scanned for @custom_control Go handlers. Resolved relative to CWD. Env: comma-separated. Environment variable: MANUL_CUSTOM_CONTROLS_DIRS.

log_name_maxlen.description: If > 0, truncates element names in console log output to this many characters. Environment variable: MANUL_LOG_NAME_MAXLEN.

log_thought_maxlen.description: If > 0, truncates verbose 'thought'/diagnostic strings in console log output. Environment variable: MANUL_LOG_THOUGHT_MAXLEN.

workers.description: Max hunt files to run in parallel. Each worker spawns a separate subprocess with its own browser. Forced to 1 when --debug or --break-lines is active. Environment variable: MANUL_WORKERS.

tests_home.description: Default directory for new hunt files, SCAN PAGE output, and manul scan default output. JSON-only — no env var override.

auto_annotate.description: Automatically inject '# 📍 Auto-Nav: <name>' comments into .hunt files whenever the page URL changes during a run. Page names from pages.json. Environment variable: MANUL_AUTO_ANNOTATE.

channel.description: Browser channel — selects an installed binary of the engine named by `browser` (chrome, msedge, chromium, firefox-esr, firefox-nightly, ...). An unknown value is treated as a bare binary name to look up on PATH. Environment variable: MANUL_CHANNEL.

executable_path.description: Absolute path to a custom browser or Electron app executable. Used with OPEN APP command for desktop automation. Environment variable: MANUL_EXECUTABLE_PATH.

cdp_endpoint.description: The endpoint to dial when attaching. Its scheme selects the protocol: an HTTP endpoint (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222) is CDP/Chromium, a WebSocket URL (e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:9222/session) is WebDriver BiDi/Firefox — a bare ws://host:port, as Firefox prints it at startup, gets /session appended. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9222 in attach mode. Setting it also *implies* attach when browser_mode is empty — inference kept for existing configs; prefer setting browser_mode explicitly. Environment variable: MANUL_CDP_ENDPOINT.

retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed hunt file. Pass on retry marks status as 'flaky'. Environment variable: MANUL_RETRIES.

screenshot.description: Screenshot capture mode for hunt runs: PNG files under screenshots/ in the working directory, recorded on each step result as screenshot_path and linked from the HTML report. Environment variable: MANUL_SCREENSHOT.

html_report.description: Generate self-contained HTML report after the run (reports/manul_report.html). Recent invocations merged via report session state. Environment variable: MANUL_HTML_REPORT.

explain_mode.description: Print detailed per-channel heuristic score breakdown for each element resolution. Environment variable: MANUL_EXPLAIN.
